# Profitable Agent Stack

> Cost-first directory of AI GTM tools ranked by use-case fit, published price and user sentiment, with estimated monthly stack costs by company stage. Prices checked 2026-10-26; verify with vendors. Not advice.

## Tools
- Google Search Console (SEO & content; stages: solo, growth, later): Free (Google describes it as a free service). Value score: 100. Source: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9128668
- Framer (Landing pages & websites; stages: solo, growth): Free $0 (Framer domain); Basic $10/mo, Pro $30/mo (yearly-billing view; monthly-billing price not verified). Value score: 100. Source: https://www.framer.com/pricing
- beehiiv (Newsletters; stages: solo, growth, later): Free forever (1,000-subscriber view); Lite $49/mo yearly billing; Pro $95/mo yearly billing. Value score: 100. Source: https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing
- Instantly (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth, later): Outreach: Growth $47/mo (5,000 emails), Hypergrowth $97/mo (125,000 emails, 25,000 contacts), Light Speed $358/mo (500,000 emails); monthly billing view. Credits plans (e.g. Growth Credits $47/mo) are separate. Value score: 94. Source: https://instantly.ai/pricing
- Smartlead (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth): Base from $39/mo (pricing page also lists Pro, Smart, Prime tiers). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.smartlead.ai/pricing
- Exa (List building & lead data; stages: solo, growth): Free $10 credits/mo; Search from $4 per 1k requests (usage-based). Value score: 88. Source: https://exa.ai/pricing
- Hunter (Enrichment & verification; stages: solo, growth, later): Free (50 credits); Starter $49/mo monthly ($34 annual); Growth $149 ($104); Scale $299 ($209). Value score: 88. Source: https://hunter.io/pricing
- FullEnrich (Enrichment & verification; stages: growth, later): Free trial; Pro 15K credits $720/mo; other credit tiers on page. Value score: 88. Source: https://fullenrich.com/pricing
- Waalaxy (LinkedIn outreach; stages: solo, growth): €19, €49, €69 per user/mo; 14-day free trial (EUR). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.waalaxy.com/pricing
- HeyGen (Design & video; stages: solo, growth, later): Free $0; Creator $29/mo; Pro $49/mo; Business $149/mo. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.heygen.com/pricing
- RB2B (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, growth): Free $0; Starter $79/mo; Pro from $149; Pro+ from $199. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.rb2b.com/pricing
- PostHog (Signals, intent & analytics; stages: solo, growth, later): Free monthly allowance (e.g. 1M analytics events), then usage-based. Value score: 88. Source: https://posthog.com/pricing
- Ahrefs Free (SEO & content; stages: solo, growth): Free: site audit and SEO metrics for websites you verify (formerly Ahrefs Webmaster Tools); paid plans not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://ahrefs.com/webmaster-tools
- Buffer (Social scheduling; stages: solo, growth, later): Free: up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel; Essentials $5/mo per channel (monthly); Team $10/mo per channel. Value score: 88. Source: https://buffer.com/pricing
- Typefully (Social scheduling; stages: solo, growth): Free plan available; paid plan prices not captured. Value score: 88. Source: https://typefully.com/
- Carrd (Landing pages & websites; stages: solo, growth): Free account; Pro Lite $9/yr, Pro Standard $19/yr (custom domain), up to $69/yr for 50 sites. Value score: 88. Source: https://carrd.co/pro
- Webflow (Landing pages & websites; stages: growth, later): Free (webflow.io domain); site plans Basic $15/mo billed yearly, CMS plan $25/mo billed yearly. Value score: 88. Source: https://webflow.com/pricing
- Descript (Design & video; stages: solo, growth): Free $0; Hobbyist $16/mo yearly ($24 monthly); Creator $24 yearly ($35 monthly); Business $50 yearly ($65 monthly), per person. Value score: 88. Source: https://www.descript.com/pricing

## Stage stacks (estimates)
### Solo founder monetizing an idea: $69.58/mo + €19 Waalaxy
Assumptions: 1 person, 1 LinkedIn account, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing, entry tiers. Marketing: free tiers used where they exist; Carrd priced yearly ÷ 12.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Smartlead, Base, 1 workspace, $39 — Lowest published entry price for outbound email in our list.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Free plan (50 credits), $0 — Free plan covers email finding/verification at solo volume.
- List building & lead data: Exa, Free $10 credits/mo, $0 — Free credits for finding target companies; Hunter then finds the emails.
- LinkedIn outreach: Waalaxy, 1 user × €19 (EUR, not converted), $0 — Cheapest listed LinkedIn tool (per user, EUR).
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Free product analytics allowance.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Free plan, $0 — Free website-visitor identification; a different signal from product analytics.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Standard, $29 — Social scheduling for founder-led content.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party search data: which queries bring visitors. Ahrefs Free is a good second look but would overlap.
- Landing pages & websites: Carrd, Pro Standard, $19/yr ÷ 12, $1.58 — Cheapest custom-domain landing page in our list; $19/yr is the yearly price on its Pro page.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Free forever plan; upgrade to Lite ($49/mo yearly) only when monetizing.
- Design & video: CapCut, Free, $0 — Free video editing for short clips; Canva (price not verified) is an optional design add-on and is not counted.
### Pre-seed to Series A, growing: $460/mo 
Assumptions: 3 people, 2 LinkedIn senders, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing. Marketing: Surfer and Framer at their lowest listed paid tiers (yearly-billing view); Canva and Discord optional and not counted.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Growth, $47 — Top value score for outbound; unlimited mailboxes on one plan. Its lead credits are not added because Hunter covers enrichment.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Starter, $49 — Finding and verifying emails, so no second data plan is needed.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 2 senders, $158 — Per-sender pricing scales with 2 founders/SDRs on LinkedIn.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Starter, $79 — Identifies site visitors to feed outbound.
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Product analytics on the free allowance.
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: Artisan, Optional — contact sales, not included, $0 — Optional; only if you want an AI SDR instead of hiring one.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Team, $39 — Social scheduling for a small team.
- Design & video: HeyGen, Creator (video), $29 — Video creation (a separate job from scheduling): demos and outbound videos.
- SEO & content: Google Search Console, Free, $0 — Free first-party search data; tracks whether content ranks.
- SEO & content: Surfer, Discovery, billed yearly, $49 — Content optimization is a separate job from tracking; Discovery is its lowest listed tier.
- Landing pages & websites: Framer, Basic (yearly-billing price), $10 — Design-led pages with custom domain; Basic is its lowest paid tier. Monthly-billing price not verified.
- Newsletters: beehiiv, Free plan, $0 — Free until you monetize; Lite is $49/mo yearly billing.
- Design & video: Canva, Optional, price not verified, $0 — Common design pick, but its pricing page blocked our fetch, so it is not counted. HeyGen already covers video.
- Community: Discord, Optional, price not verified, $0 — Free-to-start community option, but no vendor price was captured, so it is not counted.
### Later stage, 10+ people: $3,884/mo 
Assumptions: 10+ people, 10 LinkedIn senders, high email volume, monthly list prices except Common Room (billed annually).
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Hypergrowth (125,000 emails/mo), $97 — Fits a 10+ team: 125,000 emails/mo and 25,000 contacts on the vendor page (Light Speed, $358/mo, is for 500,000 emails/mo). Corrected 2026-10-28: we previously used $358, which was a misread of the bundle table.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Scale, $299 — Scale tier for team-wide email finding and verification.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 10 senders, $790 — One sender per rep on LinkedIn.
- Social scheduling: Postiz, Pro, $49 — Social scheduling across a marketing team.
- Design & video: HeyGen, Business (video), $149 — Video creation (separate job from scheduling).
- Signals, intent & analytics: Common Room, Essential (billed annually, 5 seats), $2500 — Intent and community signals across channels; replaces RB2B at this stage.
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: 11x / Qualified, Contact sales, not included, $0 — Optional AI SDR; price on request.

## Methodology
Value = 50% fit (editorial) + 30% cost + 20% sentiment; sentiment not yet verified so fit/cost reweighted 62.5/37.5.

## Disclaimer
Profitable Agent Stack is for general information only, provided "as is" without warranties. Prices, plans, features and review data change often and may be inaccurate or out of date (last checked 2026-10-26); always verify with the vendor. Cost estimates and scores are editorial estimates, not advice. Nothing here is professional, legal or financial advice. Trademarks belong to their owners; listing is not endorsement. Some links may be affiliate or sponsored — see our Disclosure.
